with_cinder.speaker: cinder
with_cinder.text: Here. The knot. It is not a thing, it is a direction: down and east, under a place with pews. The Choir keeps one of the Keys there and my thread is wound round it. Cut it here and I am free and the Key is loose. Follow it and I stay tied, and we know the way.

choices.text: Cut it. Nobody gets to keep you.
Follow it. We need that Key.

cut.speaker: cinder
cut.text: Quiet. I did not know it was loud until now. Thank you. I will still remember the Sundering; that was never the tether's.

followed.speaker: cinder
followed.text: Then I know the way to the Cathedral, and it knows I am coming. Fair.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A knot of Weft-thread pulled taut into the dark, down and east. Something at the other end is a Key. Something at this end was a person.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Cinder's tether hangs slack. Whatever held him has let go, now that there is nothing to hold.
